meta.description: Two flows. Outbound: JAL-SAKSHI POSTs a signed work order, the workflow verifies the signature and sends the pre-rendered text to the crew's Telegram chat. Inbound: a reply is relayed to the FastAPI callback, which starts sensor verification. The workflow deliberately holds no logic about water: it does not decide who to send, what the SLA is, or whether anything may close.
